say:1:1621230001:0.text: Mr. Hamell, those people just now... what did they mean by "last chance"?
say:1:1621230001:0.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生，刚才那些人说的“最后期限”……是什么意思？

say:2:1621230002:0.text: Them? Just collectors looking for their cut. The association grant is on its way—no need to worry about me.
say:2:1621230002:0.source_cn: 那些人……不过是一群来收租的而已，协会的补助还在路上，...

say:3:1621230003:0.text: For small groups like ours, we learn to patch the roof before the storm hits.
say:3:1621230003:0.source_cn: 像我们这种角落里的小组织，向来要在风雨来临前，先把屋顶钉牢。

choice_prompt:4:1621230003.text: For small groups like ours, we learn to patch the roof before the storm hits.
choice_prompt:4:1621230003.source_cn: 像我们这种角落里的小组织，向来要在风雨来临前，先把屋顶钉牢。

say:5:1621230004:0.text: You actually lugged these solid metal things back? Bare hands and all?
say:5:1621230004:0.source_cn: 你们……将这些铁制的实心家伙带回来了，光用手搬的吗？

say:6:1621230005:1.text: It wasn't too hard. But the traps had traces of magic. Whoever set them wasn't just an ordinary hunter.
say:6:1621230005:1.source_cn: 对我们来说不算难，不过……这些陷阱上有魔法痕迹，似乎不...

say:7:1621230006:1.text: Mr. Hamell... any idea who might've set them?
say:7:1621230006:1.source_cn: 哈梅尔先生，你知道是谁干的吗？

say:8:1621230007:1.text: That... isn't something you need to deal with right now. Leave it to me.
say:8:1621230007:1.source_cn: 这事啊……现在还不该由你们去操心，我会处理好的。

choice_prompt:9:1621230007.text: That... isn't something you need to deal with right now. Leave it to me.
choice_prompt:9:1621230007.source_cn: 这事啊……现在还不该由你们去操心，我会处理好的。

say:10:1621230008:1.text: Heh... you two showing up like this—it's like spring stumbling into a snowstorm, bringing light and warmth where it shouldn't be.
say:10:1621230008:1.source_cn: 呵，你们啊……真像是初春闯进雪夜的旅人，带着光，也带着热。

say:11:1621230009:1.text: But remember, even with company, some storms you still have to weather on your own.
say:11:1621230009:1.source_cn: 不过别忘了，就算有人陪着，也未必能抵挡所有风雪。

say:12:1621230010:1.text: Still... thanks for being here anyway.

say:13:1621230015:1.text: You've done well. There's more I want to tell you, but not yet.
say:13:1621230015:1.source_cn: 你们做得很好，下一阶段的考验，我晚点告诉你们。

say:14:1621230016:0.text: I've got something to handle first. I'll catch up later.
say:14:1621230016:0.source_cn: 我还有些私事要处理，先走一步。

say:16:1621230017:1.text: And with that, Hamell hurries off, like a man heading to an appointment he can't afford to miss.
say:16:1621230017:1.source_cn: 说完，哈梅尔像赶赴一场旧约定似的，匆匆离开了。

say:17:1621230018:1.text: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?
say:17:1621230018:1.source_cn: 梅林大人……你有没有觉得，他好像在隐瞒什么？
say:17:1621230018:1.male: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?
say:17:1621230018:1.female: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?

choice_prompt:18:1621230018.text: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?
choice_prompt:18:1621230018.source_cn: 梅林大人……你有没有觉得，他好像在隐瞒什么？
choice_prompt:18:1621230018.male: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?
choice_prompt:18:1621230018.female: Magister... is it just me, or do you think he's hiding something?

say:19:1621230019:1.text: Yeah. He kept changing the subject. It was clear something was eating at him.
say:19:1621230019:1.source_cn: 我也有这种感觉。他太快就转移话题了，明明心里还有事。
say:19:1621230019:1.male: Yeah. He kept changing the subject. It was clear something was eating at him.
say:19:1621230019:1.female: Yeah. He kept changing the subject. It was clear something was eating at him.

say:20:1621230023:1.text: Whatever the truth is, those poachers are still out there. Let's stick to the plan and patrol tonight.
say:20:1621230023:1.source_cn: 不过不论真相如何，偷猎者还在森林里，今晚我们按计划去巡...
say:20:1621230023:1.male: Whatever the truth is, those poachers are still out there. Let's stick to the plan and patrol tonight.
say:20:1621230023:1.female: Whatever the truth is, those poachers are still out there. Let's stick to the plan and patrol tonight.

say:22:1621230020:1.text: Yeah... Maybe he's carrying someone else's burden, trying to protect them.
say:22:1621230020:1.source_cn: 嗯……也许他是在替别人担着什么吧。
say:22:1621230020:1.male: Yeah... Maybe he's carrying someone else's burden, trying to protect them.
say:22:1621230020:1.female: Yeah... Maybe he's carrying someone else's burden, trying to protect them.

choice:18:1:2.text: Maybe he had a good reason.
choice:18:1:2.male: Maybe he had a good reason.
choice:18:1:2.female: Maybe he had a good reason.

say:23:1621230021:1.text: ... Are you saying he's working with them?
say:23:1621230021:1.male: ... Are you saying he's working with them?
say:23:1621230021:1.female: ... Are you saying he's working with them?

say:24:1621230022:1.text: His reactions were... well, he dodged every hard question.
say:24:1621230022:1.source_cn: 他的反应……确实太避重就轻了。
say:24:1621230022:1.male: His reactions were... well, he dodged every hard question.
say:24:1621230022:1.female: His reactions were... well, he dodged every hard question.

choice:18:2:3.text: Maybe he's covering for the poachers.
choice:18:2:3.male: Maybe he's covering for the poachers.
choice:18:2:3.female: Maybe he's covering for the poachers.

say:25:1621230011:1.text: Some things... are like fixing a cracked old flute. Only the one who's played it knows how it's meant to sound.
say:25:1621230011:1.source_cn: 这件事，就像修补一支开裂的旧笛子——只有笛主知道它该发...

say:26:1621230012:1.text: I know you mean well. But this verse... I need to play it solo.
say:26:1621230012:1.source_cn: 你们的好意我明白，不过这一段……就让我一个人吹完吧。

say:27:1621230013:1.text: I know. They're not lost hikers who took a wrong turn. They mean business.
say:27:1621230013:1.source_cn: 我知道，他们可不是走错林子的小角色。

say:28:1621230014:1.text: I've had to tread lightly all these years—because one wrong step, and you wouldn't be looking at me in one piece. Ha!
say:28:1621230014:1.source_cn: 这些年我一直很小心——不然你们今天看到的，可能就不是个...
